entries.title: Graduate Research Assistant
entries.organization: University of Washington, Seattle, WA
bullets: Conducted a scoping review of peer-reviewed literature on the ethical use of digital trace data (e.g., social media, search histories) from caregivers of individuals with Alzheimer's disease and related dementias (ADRD), including systematic searching, screening, and data extraction across multiple databases.

Developed and applied a structured data extraction framework to assess reporting of ethical oversight (e.g., IRB approval), privacy, and consent considerations, synthesizing findings to identify gaps in ethical transparency in research involving vulnerable populations.

entries.title: Doctoral Researcher
entries.organization: University of Washington, Seattle, WA
bullets: Designed and implemented three mixed-methods research studies on how individuals experience and seek support after discovering misattributed parentage through genetic testing.
Led 27 remote one-hour interviews over 4 months.
Qualitatively synthesized 4,000+ Reddit posts and comments from genetic testing users, leading to an academic paper.
Recruited and supervised undergraduate second coders for each aim.

bullets: Synthesized 39 implementation reports into a consolidated learning report on HPV vaccine rollout in Nigeria.

entries.title: Graduate Research Assistant
entries.organization: Treuman Katz Center for Pediatric Bioethics and Palliative Care, University of Washington (with Kate MacDuffie, MA, PhD)
bullets: Conducted qualitative research (coding, data analysis, and manuscript preparation) on ethical considerations in pediatric genomic medicine, focusing on how whole genome sequencing impacts parents' experiences in the NICU and with children with developmental differences.

Recruited, managed, and led manuscript writing of an expert consensus-building working group to improve transparency and ongoing communication in brain organoid research, particularly in donor consent practices.
